definitions.explanation: Organized extracurricular activities at schools, typically sports teams, cultural clubs, or academic groups. A defining feature of Japanese school life from middle school through university.

examples.japanese: {部活動|ぶかつどう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What club activities do you participate in?

examples.japanese: ⟦{放課後|ほうかご}→放課後：12720_houkago⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{部活動|ぶかつどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are club activities every day after school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中学校|ちゅうがっこう}→中学校：01465_chuugakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{部活動|ぶかつどう}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ほぼ→ほぼ：00109_hobo⟧⟦{必須|ひっす}→必須：12516_hissu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In middle school, participation in club activities is practically required.

notes:
Often shortened to ⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧ in everyday speech. This is one of the most distinctive aspects of Japanese school culture, with students expected to commit seriously to a single club throughout the school year.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {部活動|ぶかつどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to join a club)
- {部活動|ぶかつどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|や}める (to quit a club)
- {部活動|ぶかつどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{励|はげ}む→励む：11822_hagemu⟧ (to devote oneself to club activities)

USAGE:
{部活動|ぶかつどう} is the formal term used in school documents and by teachers. Students almost always say ⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧ in conversation.
